author: A. B. Schroeder
title: West End School records 36 Asian and Pacific Islander students for 2025-26
text:
West End School had 36 Asian and Pacific Islander students enrolled for the 2025-26 school year, reflecting a 5.3% decrease from the prior year, based on figures from the New York State Education Department .
The data indicated that West End School enrolled a total of 373 students during 2025-26. Asian and Pacific Islander students made up 9.7% of the school’s population, making this group the third largest ethnicity represented.
The campus is part of Lynbrook Union Free School District, with the district’s administrative office located in Lynbrook.
Out of the seven schools in the district, Lynbrook Senior High School reported the highest number of Asian and Pacific Islander students at that time, enrolling 65 students.
World Population Review reported that New York’s public education system ranked second nationally overall but was 31st for K-12 academic performance.
